finding.applies_when: auth.isInternal() || auth.isDev() (the form's staff predicate, TicketCenter.tsx:211) AND the firm the form files under is one of the READY firms (advisorLoginEmailApplies in AnalysisRequestParts.tsx). A partner is never asked: the door's rule is documented for an internal subject's CREATE (served.py:1063-1073).
finding.caveat: An internal caller whose users row carries no allowedFirmIds (or an empty list) is unrestricted: every firm is READY, so the client cannot tell that filer from a listed one. Its door would not demand an advisor, and a present advisor_email would change the owner to the named advisor. Filed as surprise row IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-W170-S4 (ARMED, disarm owner 1.0.0_SA_CTO).
finding.stop_check: The form does have a way to read the filer's list (the served READY set, which the portal's own comment at TicketCenter.tsx:96-99 calls the profile's allowed firms), so no STOP was taken. The caveat above is the residue.

refusal_body.source: infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/_authz/served.py (HEAD 9f1e81226a): refuse() at line 453, status_envelope() at line 339, REFUSAL_STATE at line 199; the upload handler's except clause (just above line 1062) maps a ProspectOwnershipRefused to the code NOT_AUTHORIZED and then calls refuse()

shape.firm_id: carried when known, omitted when not

not_in_body: any message text (the door's reason words, for example 'an on-behalf upload must name the firm advisor' or 'advisor profile absent, disabled or of another firm', are written to the server log by _record and are not returned)
refusal_body.http_status: refuse() returns a dict with ok false and no statusCode, which the HTTP API passes as 200 (the S157 row, IRPT_ANLREQ-D2-S157, world_is, cites served.py:483-499 for this)
refusal_body.client_path: src/api/endpoints/investor-reporting.ts send() (about line 1059): an envelope-shaped body is parsed; a refused one throws IrRequestError(message, operation, httpStatus, publicReasonCode) (class at line 938); the publicReasonCode is the closed code
refusal_body.form_path: analysisRequest.ts uploadRefusalCode(e) returns the code from FilingStepError(step 'upload').original; TicketCenter.tsx sets uploadReport.refusal; UploadFindings renders it under the failure sentence UPLOAD_FAILED_SENTENCE
refusal_body.consequence: The refusal the form can show is the closed code only. A wrong login email and every other NOT_AUTHORIZED refusal look the same to the filer; the door's own words are not shown, because the body does not carry them. Not exercised against the live door.

gateway: Whether the gateway forwards the advisor_email query member to the door was not read (not_read).
